deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'set -eu; attempt=1; while ! php artisan db:show --database=mysql >/dev/null 2>&1; do if [ "$attempt" -ge 60 ]; then echo "MySQL did not become reachable after 120 seconds" >&2; php artisan db:show --database=mysql; exit 1; fi; echo "Waiting for MySQL ($attempt/60)..."; attempt=$((attempt + 1)); sleep 2; done; php artisan migrate --seed --force; exec php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=${PORT:-8080}'
